name: Thông báo hủy hợp đồng do lập nhầm
prompt: Create ONE production-quality Vietnamese transactional email visual, not a website. 1024x1024 square compact email; entire email visible, white outer margin, natural centered 600px layout, no browser chrome. AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCE: attached image is the exact user-approved AN KHANG HOME email crop. Preserve its real white logo plaque with navy/green AK + AN KHANG HOME wordmark, emerald illustrated apartment-building banner, large white headline at left, illustration at right, curved pale mint lower edge, left-aligned body, thin fact dividers, signature. Match the reference closely; do not invent a different brand. EXACT TEMPLATE: Thông báo hủy hợp đồng do lập nhầm; audience Khách thuê; banner headline exactly 'THÔNG BÁO HỦY HỢP ĐỒNG'. Semantic palette: slate; original logo colors remain navy/green. Banner illustration: cream apartment building and clearly inactive contract document, neutral cancellation symbol. Use a refined flat editorial illustration, not 3D. Date anchor 09/10/2026 Vietnam UTC+7; all supplied facts are synthetic and exact. BODY: Xin chào Nguyễn Minh Anh, Hợp đồng Phòng 999 đã được hủy do lập nhầm.  Facts: Phòng: Phòng 999; Mã hợp đồng: HD-MAU-999; Thời điểm hủy: 09/10/2026 · 10:00; Lý do: Lập nhầm thông tin hợp đồng.  Closing: Bản hợp đồng và link xác nhận cũ không còn hiệu lực. Bạn không cần xác nhận hay thao tác thêm. No button and no external link; the message must be complete in the email. Close with 'Trân trọng,' and 'Đội ngũ An Khang Home'. Add tiny footer 'Dữ liệu minh họa · 09/10/2026'. This is a compact overdue reminder with short body, only two fact rows, one balance and minimal banner detail. AVOID: Gmail/browser UI, tabs, device frame, other brands, SPX, QR, passwords, fake phone/contact details, clutter, cards inside cards, multiple CTAs, repeated headings, tiny unreadable text, clipped footer, misspelled Vietnamese, unsupported success stamp, invented amounts, people, photorealistic luxury real estate, code or HTML annotations. CRITICAL PALETTE OVERRIDE: preserve the reference layout and illustration style, but RECOLOR THE ENTIRE LARGE BANNER BACKGROUND to slate. The semantic color must dominate the banner, not merely appear in a tiny icon. Only the original AK logo retains navy/green. Do not keep the emerald banner for this template. CRITICAL COMPACT OVERRIDE: fit entire email in 1024x1024. Reduce the illustrated banner to roughly 240px high; use a modest 32px headline, smaller logo, simple building/document vignette at right. Body is concise, only two fact rows (or the supplied cancellation facts), balance once; minimal whitespace, no tall banner, no excessive vertical padding. All text and footer must remain comfortably readable.
